name: zmodel_set_texture_world_base
description: zModel::SetTextureWorldBase stores the global U/V base coordinates for world-space texture projection.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zModel source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4760b0 validates a stdcall leaf that stores the two stack arguments to g_zModel_TextureWorldBaseU and g_zModel_TextureWorldBaseV and returns with callee cleanup for 8 bytes.
The native smoke verifies both base globals are updated and that the per-meter globals are not modified by this setter.
